text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Japan has agreed to provide $26.5 million for the reconstruction of 10 bridges wrecked by war and flood in the Zambezi Valley of central Mozambique.

- The Mozambican parliament is divided over a clause in the new national defence and armed forces bill which would allow its troops to serve in international peacekeeping operations. The opposition Renamo party says parliament should have an active role in decisions about where the army can be sent, while the majority Frelimo party wants this left to the president, acting on proposals by the government. Frelimo argues that consulting parliament would take too long.
